summary: Created `desk:apps:temp` and confirmed empty input, `25 → 77`, backspace behavior, ignored characters, and `-40 → -40`.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give {c: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
set s.c to edit_text(s.c, k)
or when '0123456789-.' has k
set s.c to edit_text(s.c, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.c)
when is_number(s.c)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & (number(s.c) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
